attributes.action: Stringent Checks on ALL adopting Parents (Tighter Regulations)
attributes.additional_details:
Enhanced Background and Digital Screening
Post Adoption Welfare Monitoring 
Independent Psychological Assessments 
Review Adoptive Parents Medical Record

attributes.background: Strengthen adoption laws by requiring enhanced background checks, mental health assessments, financial checks, medical reviews, regular social worker visits after adoption, and monitoring of substance misuse to improve child safeguarding and welfare
